Gateway management (iSCSI, NFS, NVMe-oF)

Usage:
  haify gateway [command]

Available Commands:
  delete      Delete a gateway
  get         Get gateway details
  iscsi       iSCSI gateway management
  list        List all gateways
  nfs         NFS gateway management
  nvme        NVMe-oF gateway management
  smb         SMB gateway management (workgroup: standalone Samba, local users)
  start       Start a gateway (activate resources and services)
  status      Show gateway status
  stop        Stop a gateway (demote resources and stop services)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for gateway

Global Flags:
  -c, --controller string        Controller address (default "127.0.0.1:3374")
      --debug                    Trace every step and controller call on stderr (env HAIFY_LOG_LEVEL=debug)
      --tls                      Connect over TLS (implied by --tls-ca/--tls-cert; env HAIFY_TLS)
      --tls-ca string            CA bundle that signed the controller certificate (env HAIFY_TLS_CA; default: system trust store)
      --tls-cert string          Client certificate, for a controller requiring mutual TLS (env HAIFY_TLS_CERT)
      --tls-insecure             Encrypt but do NOT verify the controller — accepts any certificate (env HAIFY_TLS_INSECURE)
      --tls-key string           Client private key (env HAIFY_TLS_KEY)
      --tls-server-name string   Name to verify against the controller certificate (env HAIFY_TLS_SERVER_NAME)
      --token string             API token (default: HAIFY_TOKEN env, ~/.haify/token, /etc/haify/token)

Use "haify gateway [command] --help" for more information about a command.
